# eModul controller-label dictionaries

These JSON dictionaries provide controller labels from TECH's public eModul API.

| Language | Local file | Download URL |
|---|---|---|
| Czech | [cs.json](cs.json) | https://emodul.eu/api/v1/i18n/cs |
| Polish | [pl.json](pl.json) | https://emodul.eu/api/v1/i18n/pl |
| English | [en.json](en.json) | https://emodul.eu/api/v1/i18n/en |

The dictionaries are supplied as downloaded, without translating or rewriting
their entries. The mapping is available in the JSON `data` object.
